Meet Nancy

Nancy White is a self-taught mixed-media abstract artist based in Las Vegas. Art has been her lifelong passion, and over the past decade she has pushed her work into new techniques and materials, with the goal of creating pieces that stir real emotion.

Surfaces
Canvas, tile, wood, glass and resin
Techniques
Fluid acrylics, stains, water, torches, airflow and gravity
Her work
Commissions, local art shows and private collections

A piece made for your space

Tell Nancy about the room, the size and the colors you love. She'll create a one-of-a-kind commission made for it.
